title: A Wolf for the Oath
author: Silas Almeida
blurb: Freya Delacroix, a bone-carver who hears the dead, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists before the long winter finishes falling.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
